title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Honami's birthday
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho, Saki!
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're here to celebrate your birthday, of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here we go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Shiho & Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We should be the ones thanking you.
You've done so much for me, not only in class but also in the cleanup committee.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You help with our studies, band stuff and...
Band stuff, and band stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That was a lot of band stuff.
But, that kind of makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've helped us gather our thoughts and given us advice whenever we're troubled about something. There's been so many times when I've been glad you were there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
Which is why today will be a—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona Gratitude Day♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Gratitude day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! So we'll be your helpers for the whole day♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Helpers?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Come, Hona!
Your seat is right this way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Give me your bag, Honami. I'll carry it over to your seat for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Are you feeling thirsty?
I actually prepared some herbal tea for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll be taking lots of pictures for you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-This is a little embarrassing, but...
I suppose I'll depend on all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please do♪ Here, sit down.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome to Saki's hair salon! Today's service will be on the house! Any requests?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know this kind of service was available. In that case, whatever you think would look good on me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here's some chamomile tea, Honami. I prepared it when I was still at home, so it's not quite hot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay. I think that will make it easier to drink.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sniff*
It smells so nice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, there's a shot!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I got the textbooks for first period out and ready for you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're doing that much for me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. But don't think I'll do your homework too, alright?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hey, I wouldn't ask for something like that.
Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
Is Honami here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Hanasato!
And Kiritani and Shizuku, you're here too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello, Mochizuki. Do you have some time right now?
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Honami.
This isn't a cake, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, these waffle sandwiches look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We asked one of the staff at the TV station we went to today if there was a dessert shop nearby, and they told us about this one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They recommended these waffle sandwiches right off the bat and we thought they'd be a great gift for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It is your birthday, after all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We wanted to give you something as thanks for always supporting us and cheering us on in terms of our idol activities.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yup! Thank you, Honami!
Let's keep supporting each other.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kiritani, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope we can continue being there for each other too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright then, let's enjoy these together. Which one would you like, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll have... Oh, this chocolate one.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow! It's so soft and fluffy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't it? The shop staff said that the waffle just melts with the cream in your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? I'm going to take a bite...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Mmm! It does melt in your mouth!
It's so much softer than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The cream is flavorful as well, but it doesn't linger on the palate. It's really good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad you like it!
Oh, please feel free to have some more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
In that case... I'll try the mango one next.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We got to try this one at the shop. It's so good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I recommend the strawberry. Out of all of the ones we got to try, I liked this one the most.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You two act so fast, that's not fair.
I have a recommendation for you too, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. But, is it alright for me to have so many?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. We were able to try these flavors when we were buying them at the shop.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, the shop doesn't use a lot of sugar in the cream, so you can indulge a little without feeling bad!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
Then, I think I'll have another one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! Help yourself!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Which flavor should I try next...
You recommend the strawberry, right, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
Shizuku, didn't you have a flavor to recommend too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right, I almost forgot!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I recommend the matcha cream. Though the cream is light, it's very fragrant and you can really taste the matcha flavor.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds delicious too!
Hehe, I think I'll have both.
